PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
Senior Securities Services and Operational Risk professional with 19+ years of experience across Custody Operations, 
Fund Accounting, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation and Operational Risk & Controls within BNY Mellon. Experienced in 
Operational Risk Event (ORE) reviews, Risk Control Self-Assessment (RCSA), risk and control reviews, control-gap 
identification, remediation tracking, KRI monitoring, regulatory reporting and risk governance. Proven ability to partner with 
Risk, Compliance, Technology, Product, Operations and First Line of Defence (1LOD) stakeholders to identify and mitigate 
operational risks, strengthen control environments and support audit and regulatory requirements. Strong Securities 
Services foundation spanning Custody, Fund Accounting, Corporate Actions, cash/position reconciliation and post-trade 
processing, complemented by team leadership, process governance and control improvement experience.
